detail.readme_excerpt:
**[Docs](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/?ref=github_readme)** · **[Examples](https://www.copilotkit.ai/examples?ref=github_readme)** · **[Intelligence](https://www.copilotkit.ai/copilotkit-intelligence?ref=github_readme)** · **[OpenBot](https://open.bot/?ref=github_readme)** · **[Discord](https://discord.gg/6dffbvGU3D?ref=github_readme)**



**CopilotKit is the open-source stack for putting AI agents in front of real users.** Bring the agent you already built, on any framework, and give it chat, generative UI, shared state, and human-in-the-loop in React, Angular, Vue, React Native, Slack, and Microsoft Teams. When it goes to production, add **CopilotKit Intelligence** and your agents keep getting better: conversations that pick up where users left off, memory across sessions, and **Continual Learning** that turns real use into Skills you review and publish. We're also the team behind **[AG-UI](https://github.com/ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui)**, the open Agent–User Interaction protocol adopted by Google, Microsoft, AWS, LangChain, Mastra, PydanticAI, and more. ## What's new | What's new | What it is | | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------
